title: qBittorrent
description: The qBittorrent project aims to provide an open-source software alternative to µTorrent. For hardlinked imports, give this app and Sonarr/Radarr the same DATA path. In qBittorrent, set the default save path to /data/downloads.

parameters.label: QBITTORRENT /DATA
parameters.description: Host folder mounted at /data. Use the same path for all your media apps and keep it on one filesystem, with downloads/ and media/ inside it. It must be writable by PUID/PGID.
